CQ:other_goals.name: Other Goals Question
CQ:other_goals.question_template_en: Is there another goal of {P} that {G} itself would clash with?

CQ:other_means.name: Other Means Question
CQ:other_means.question_template_en: Could {P} realize {G} more effectively by another action than {A}: more surely, sooner or at lower cost?

CQ:side_effect.name: Side Effects Question
CQ:side_effect.question_template_en: Would doing {A} also bring about something bad?

CQ:best_means.name: Best Means Question
CQ:best_means.question_template_en: Of {A} and the other actions open to {P}, which would achieve {G}, or reach {S2}, most surely, soonest or at least cost?

CQ:evidence.name: Evidence Question
CQ:evidence.question_template_en: What evidence shows that doing {A} would lead to {G}, and is it strong enough for the confidence with which the claim is made?

CQ:likelihood.name: Likelihood Question
CQ:likelihood.question_template_en: How likely is it that doing {A} would actually lead to {G}?

CQ:other_event.name: Other Event Question
CQ:other_event.question_template_en: Would some cause other than {B} account better for the observed {A}?

CQ:expertise.name: Expertise Question
CQ:expertise.question_template_en: Does {W} really have the knowledge of {D}, and the standing in it, that the argument credits {W} with?

CQ:field.name: Field Question
CQ:field.question_template_en: Is {S} a matter that {D}, the domain in which {W} is cited, actually covers?

CQ:opinion.name: Opinion Question
CQ:opinion.question_template_en: Did {W} in fact put {S} forward as true, in words that amount to {S} or imply it?

CQ:trustworthiness.name: Trustworthiness Question
CQ:trustworthiness.question_template_en: Is there reason to doubt {W}'s personal reliability as a source, such as bias, dishonesty or carelessness?

CQ:consistency.name: Consistency Question
CQ:consistency.question_template_en: Does what other experts in {D} say conflict with {S}?

CQ:backup_evidence.name: Backup Evidence Question
CQ:backup_evidence.question_template_en: Has {W} any data, study or observation behind the claim that {S}, or is it an unsupported view?

CQ:position.name: Position to Know Question
CQ:position.question_template_en: Does {W} have the kind of access to {D} that would let {W} know whether {S} holds?

CQ:difference.name: Difference Question
CQ:difference.question_template_en: Do the two cases differ in a way that tells against the claim carried over to the target?

CQ:truth.name: Truth Question
CQ:truth.question_template_en: Did the claim really hold in the source case?

CQ:other_case.name: Other Case Question
CQ:other_case.question_template_en: Is there another case, much like the source, in which the counterpart of the claim did not hold?

CQ:legitimate_value.name: Legitimate Value Question
CQ:legitimate_value.question_template_en: Does {A} in fact regard {V} as a positive value?

CQ:value_effect.name: Value Effect Question
CQ:value_effect.question_template_en: Does {V}'s being positive bear on {A}'s goal {G} so as to favour it?

CQ:conflicting_goals.name: Conflicting Goals Question
CQ:conflicting_goals.question_template_en: Is there another goal of {P} that {G} itself would clash with?

CQ:intervening_actions.name: Intervening Actions Question
CQ:intervening_actions.question_template_en: Would further steps be needed after {A} before {G} is achieved?

CQ:goal_possible.name: Goal Possibility Question
CQ:goal_possible.question_template_en: Can {G} be reached at all, by any means?

CQ:opposite_consequences.name: Opposite Consequences Question
CQ:opposite_consequences.question_template_en: Would doing {A} also bring about something good, to set against {G}?

CQ:bad_outweighs.name: Outweighing Harm Question
CQ:bad_outweighs.question_template_en: Would doing {A} have bad consequences that matter more than {G}?

CQ:good_outweighs.name: Outweighing Good Question
CQ:good_outweighs.question_template_en: Would doing {A} have good consequences that matter more than {G}?

CQ:too_slight.name: Slight Consequence Question
CQ:too_slight.question_template_en: Granted that doing {A} would or could bring about {G}, is {G} too slight a consequence to count in deciding on {A}? (Reaching few does not make a consequence slight: one weighty gain or harm can decide.)

CQ:gain_discounted.name: Discounted Gain Question
CQ:gain_discounted.question_template_en: Who would gain {G}, and does that make it count for less in deciding on {A}?

CQ:harm_discounted.name: Discounted Harm Question
CQ:harm_discounted.question_template_en: On whom would {G} fall, and does that make it count for less in deciding on {A}?

CQ:modal_likelihood.name: Real Chance Question
CQ:modal_likelihood.question_template_en: Is there a real chance that doing {A} leads to {G}, or is it no more than conceivable?

CQ:modal_evidence.name: Possibility Evidence Question
CQ:modal_evidence.question_template_en: What evidence shows that doing {A} could lead to {G}, and is it enough for a real possibility?

CQ:worth_finding_out_first.name: Finding Out First Question
CQ:worth_finding_out_first.question_template_en: Should the possibility that doing {A} brings about {G} be left out of the decision on {A} until it is found out: can it be found out in time, reliably enough to settle the question, at a cost and risk worth bearing? Which way?

CQ:correlation.name: Correlation Question
CQ:correlation.question_template_en: How closely does a finding like {A} go with {B}, as a dependable indicator of it or only a loose one?

CQ:honesty.name: Honesty Question
CQ:honesty.question_template_en: Is {W} a truthful and dependable source, or is there reason to doubt {W}'s word?
